name: Bond of Fauna, Greater (Faunal)
body:
In your chest beats the heart of a beast, your connection with nature granting you new animalistic powers.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Fauna, character level 9th

Benefit(s): The primal blood of beasts courses through your veins. You can cast animal aspect three times per day and blood scent and pack empathy once a day each as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
